body:
Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-26 ~21:25Z; my miss). I queued w-4a65 and w-96a0 for Sol-WinB, but both fix code that exists only in the UNLANDED w-a702 (test_run_claude_launcher_locators.rs, attach_claude_background_launcher_artifact). Sol-WinB found it at 21:15Z, released the claim cleanly and lost about 5 minutes.
Rule: before assigning an item, check that the files and functions it names exist on current master (git show origin/master:<path> or a grep). Follow-ups filed from an unlanded candidate's review depend on that candidate landing; record the dependency with update --after <candidate item>.
